$comment: inventory_allowlist is ONLY for shipped things that legitimately do not belong in the
architecture diagram, each with the reason. It is not a place to park a diagram that has
gone stale: a missing Looking Glass collector is a finding, not an allowlist entry. The
check also fails an entry that matches nothing shipped, so this list cannot rot.
needles overrides the name a diagram is searched for (matched on whole words, case and
punctuation ignored). Use it for naming variance only: the frontend container IS nginx.
inventory_regions confines a kind to one section of the diagram, from the first text naming
'from' up to the next naming 'to'. Drivers must be drawn in the data plane and integrations in
the mirrors lane: a bare product name anywhere is not enough (the FortiGate DHCP driver is not
the Fortinet FortiGate integration card). A heading that moves makes the check exit 2.

version_labels omits Kea on purpose: the docs compare Kea 2.4 / 2.6 / 3.0 behaviour throughout, so a bare 'Kea 2.6' is history far more often than a stale claim. Redis requires a major of 4+ so 'Redis 1' (a replica count) is not read as a version. Alpine also matches the image-tag form ('FROM alpine:3.24'), which the docs quote in code blocks; versions.json pins one Alpine for every agent image (#1037 moved them all to 3.24), so there is no per-image pin to choose between.

inventory_allowlist.compose:migrate: one-shot alembic job that exits; not a runtime component
inventory_allowlist.compose:dhcp-kea-2: second HA peer of dhcp-kea, same image; the diagram draws the one container
inventory_allowlist.workload:agent-landing: static landing page served on agent-only appliance nodes; no data path
inventory_allowlist.workload:kube-state-metrics: appliance observability exporter, not part of the DDI architecture
inventory_allowlist.workload:node-exporter: appliance observability exporter, not part of the DDI architecture
inventory_allowlist.workload:slot-image-mirror: serves A/B slot images to peers; an upgrade helper, not a service tier
inventory_allowlist.workload:redis-sentinel: the HA form of the redis workload; the diagram draws it as 'Redis Sentinel' under multi-node HA

identifier_ignore.PowerDNS: a product name, not a model identifier
identifier_ignore.resource_type: key inside the Role.permissions JSONB, not a column
identifier_ignore.resource_id: key inside the Role.permissions JSONB, not a column
identifier_ignore.op_id: the config-bundle / ack key carrying DNSRecordOp.id to the agent (services/dns/agent_config.py), not a column
